boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations along campus-edge corridors, each with one specific, source-backed reason to stop.

cards.title: Spurlock Museum
cards.subtitle: Gregory Street corridor, at Oregon Street
cards.notes: Enter from Gregory Street and use the galleries as a focused stop; the museum also has cultural gardens, a learning center, and an auditorium.
cards.short_summary: World-cultures galleries and museum spaces on the Gregory Street edge.
cards.evidence_claim: Spurlock Museum is at 600 S. Gregory St., at Gregory and Oregon streets, and offers permanent galleries, temporary exhibits, cultural gardens, a learning center, and an auditorium.
cards.access_notes: Check the museum visit page for current open days and visitor guidance.

cards.title: Krannert Art Museum
cards.subtitle: Peabody Drive corridor, at Sixth Street
cards.notes: Use the Peabody-and-Sixth corner for a self-paced gallery visit; ask the front desk for current exhibitions and visitor information.
cards.short_summary: A free public art museum on the Peabody Drive corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Krannert Art Museum is at the corner of Sixth Street and Peabody Drive, is always free and open to the public, and lists Tuesday–Saturday hours with Thursday evening hours during classes.
cards.source_title: Plan a Visit | Krannert Art Museum
cards.access_notes: Open Tuesday–Saturday; Thursday hours extend to 8 p.m. when classes are in session. Confirm holiday closures before going.

cards.title: Activities and Recreation Center (ARC)
cards.subtitle: Peabody Drive corridor, near First Street
cards.notes: Check the ARC schedule before heading over, then choose a facility activity such as climbing, fitness, aquatics, or a court-based session.
cards.short_summary: Large recreation facility with climbing, wellness, and court spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: The ARC at 201 E. Peabody Drive includes a climbing wall, bouldering cave, instructional kitchen, reflection room, locker rooms, and multipurpose rooms.
cards.access_notes: Facility access and program participation may depend on membership or event arrangements; consult Campus Recreation before visiting.

cards.title: Campus Recreation Center East (CRCE)
cards.subtitle: Gregory Drive corridor, near Goodwin Avenue
cards.notes: Use CRCE as the recreation stop on east Gregory; consult Campus Recreation for the current facility schedule and eligible activities.
cards.short_summary: Campus Recreation destination on the east Gregory Drive corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: The University of Illinois Campus Recreation facilities map lists Campus Recreation Center East at 1102 W. Gregory Drive in Urbana.
cards.access_notes: Check Campus Recreation for current operating hours, access rules, and program availability.

cards.title: Campus Bike Center
cards.subtitle: Gregory Drive corridor, east of First Street
cards.notes: Bring a bike question or repair goal and check the current schedule; the center is built around hands-on bicycle learning.
cards.short_summary: Hands-on bicycle learning on Gregory Drive.
cards.evidence_claim: Campus Recreation describes the Campus Bike Center as a University–Bike Project of Urbana collaboration offering hands-on experiential learning to help people fix bicycles.
cards.access_notes: The current Campus Recreation hours page lists the Campus Bike Center at 51 E. Gregory Drive; verify hours before arrival.

cards.title: Illini Grove
cards.subtitle: Pennsylvania Avenue corridor, near Lincoln Avenue
cards.notes: Plan a daytime outdoor stop around the courts and picnic area; reserve the pavilion in advance if you are organizing a group gathering.
cards.short_summary: Outdoor courts and picnic facilities along Pennsylvania Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: Campus Recreation states that Illini Grove has a rentable pavilion with a grill and tables, plus basketball, sand volleyball, and tennis courts.
cards.access_notes: Pavilion use is by rental; court and site availability can vary with scheduled programs.

cards.title: University of Illinois Ice Arena
cards.subtitle: Armory Avenue corridor, east of First Street
cards.notes: Check the event calendar for a public-skate slot, then arrive ready to rent skates if needed; schedules change around rink events.
cards.short_summary: Public skating and Learn to Skate opportunities on Armory Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: The Ice Arena at 406 E. Armory Ave. offers public skating and Learn to Skate programming; public skate, lunch skate, and extended lunch skate are open to students, staff, and the public.
cards.access_notes: Consult the Ice Arena calendar for specific public-skating dates and times. The source lists skate rental at $3.

cards.title: Japan House
cards.subtitle: Lincoln Avenue corridor, south of Kirby/Florida
cards.notes: Walk the gardens during daylight and review garden etiquette first; book ahead if you want a guided garden tour, class, or tea ceremony.
cards.short_summary: Japanese gardens and cultural programs on south Lincoln Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: Japan House is at 2000 S. Lincoln Ave.; its gardens are open dawn to dusk for self-guided walks, while tours and tea ceremonies are available by appointment.
cards.access_notes: Gardens are open dawn to dusk; the tea garden’s rocky path closes during winter. Guided tours and tea ceremonies require appointments.

cards.title: Gies Memorial Stadium
cards.subtitle: First Street corridor, south of Kirby Avenue
cards.notes: Use First Street to locate the stadium exterior and consult the official athletics schedule or gameday information before attending an event.
cards.short_summary: Illinois football’s home field on South First Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Gies Memorial Stadium, home to Illinois football, is at 1402 S. First St. in Champaign and contains Zuppke Field.
cards.source_title: Gies Memorial Stadium - Facilities | University of Illinois Athletics
cards.access_notes: Exterior viewing is straightforward; event entry, tickets, and security procedures depend on the specific event.

cards.title: State Farm Center
cards.subtitle: First Street corridor, near Kirby Avenue
cards.notes: Check the venue calendar before making the walk; use the official event listing for entry timing, ticketing, bag rules, and accessibility details.
cards.short_summary: Event arena on the South First Street corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: State Farm Center is located at 1800 South First Street, Champaign, Illinois 61820.
cards.source_title: Connect With Us | State Farm Center
cards.access_notes: Venue access is event-specific; check the official State Farm Center calendar and event guidance before visiting.
